task_name: Build Fifth Small Factory, Queue Metal, and Reposition Park for Higher Population Boost

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the 5th Small Factory is available in the Industrial menu and the newly upgraded high-rise apartment building finishes construction.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Adding the 5th Small Factory maximizes early-game raw material capacity (10 simultaneous slots). Repositioning the Small Fountain Park closer to the new high-rise apartment increases its population boost from +23 to +31.
preconditions: 1 Small Factory available in Industrial menu
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the 5th Small Factory in the northern industrial row; move the Small Fountain Park adjacent to the high-rise apartment so its green highlight covers the highest-density homes.

steps.who: Industrial Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the 5th Small Factory into the gap next to the Coal Power Plant on the northern road and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: floating Metal icons on the northern factories
steps.briefing: collect the finished Metal and drag Metal into the empty factory slots.

steps.who: Small Fountain Park (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move the park one lot to the right so it sits directly across from the tall apartment building (+31 population boost) and click the green checkmark.
